name: Richard Lovell
story: Timaru District Council’s 2016 Significant Natural Areas report names Richard Lovell among the council GIS staff who supported its ecological survey, which ran from 2005 to 2016.
The report credits Lovell and Steve Caswell with GIS work supporting the identification and mapping of significant natural areas in the Timaru district.
